# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore release notes — captured 2026-08-14
# Source used: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/release-notes.html
# (sources.json still points at doc-history.html, which renders title/nav only — recurring since
#  2026-05-18 and still unfixed)

## August 2026 — now SIX entries (was four on 2026-08-10). Both additions are below the bar.
- Memory, policy, and harness now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West).   [REGION EXPANSION]
- Runtime: Instances compute type with capacity providers.               [reported 2026-08-07]
- AWS Agent Registry launches under the `agent-registry` namespace.      [reported 2026-08-07]
- Gateway: Configurable rate limits.                                     [reported 2026-08-07]
- **NEW: Runtime — simplified and increased API rate quotas.** Data-plane APIs consolidated into a
  single adjustable 1,000 TPS/account quota (was 200 TPS); new session creation a single 25 TPS
  shared quota; control plane grouped into mutation 50 TPS / Get 150 TPS / List 25 TPS.
  [QUOTA CHANGE — no new entity type, API or capability. Held below the reporting bar.]
- **NEW: Gateway — Web Search Tool now available in Europe (Ireland) and Asia Pacific (Tokyo).**
  Same Amazon-operated index; all connector versions (1.1.0, 1.2.0) available.
  [REGION EXPANSION of an already-reported tool. Held below the reporting bar.]

## July 2026 — all reported 2026-08-07, unchanged
Gateway Web Search connector v1.2.0 (request-level filters + target include list); Identity Private
Key JWT client authentication (KMS-held private key, RS256/PS256/ES256, M2M/OBO/user-delegated);
Harness InvokeHarness streams MCP tool result metadata; Runtime unified span destination
(`/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/<agent_id>-<endpoint_name>`); Evaluations/Optimizations
PrivateLink; Evaluations expanded framework support (OpenAI Agents, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, Claude
Agent SDK + generic OTel/OpenInference); ActiveSessionCount metric; Runtime default quota increase.

## June 2026 and earlier — previously reported
Web Search Tool GA; Policy + Bedrock Guardrails; Harness GA; Recommendations GA; Batch Evaluations
GA; A/B Testing GA; Managed Knowledge Base GA; Failure Insights preview; Gateway Runtime targets GA,
HTTP passthrough targets, inference targets, inbound traffic enforcement; SOC compliance; Identity
Secrets Manager references; CLI/CDK payments support; Runtime Interactive Shells; Step Functions.

## Data-plane Actions list (API_Operations.html) — unchanged from the 2026-08-10 capture
Registry: SearchRegistryRecords remains the only registry op on this page; the AWS Agent Registry
control-plane ops (incl. ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords, BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecord) live on
a separate API surface.

Updated: 2026-08-14 — two new August entries, both a quota change and a region expansion.
**No AgentCore finding this scan.**
